notes.title: Hidden Arcade - Update V1.2.0
notes.notes:
Heyo! This is a rather small update, but I got some feedback, felt productive and put it together today. :D

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
[list]
[*] Timer Popup: In the game, in all three levels, there is a timer in the top left corner, and at the end of the level, you are put up against everyone else globally in a list, consider it a "speedrun timer". Now, there has always been the option to disable it in the Setting in the Main Menu, but for players who would not know that the timer was auto-enabled, it could feel as if they were not in full control of whether or not their data should be stored, and whether the timer is active. For that reason, for anyone new starting the game, or any other player who never made a conscious choice before, there is a [b]one-time popup[/b] when you start the game now, asking for your preference.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013671/fcbeb47f9517d5ac782229c9024d16cd79c853fb.png[/img]
[*] Permanent Progress Saving: Not everyone wants to complete an entire level in one sitting, I get that. For that reason, your progress - the time you took, the Ghosts you've clicked, the score you have - now gets permanently saved for all 3 main levels whenever you exit them via the Home Button, and it gets reloaded when you enter them again! But don't fret - if you want to restart a level to improve your time, imply play it till the end, and either click on [Restart] or [Back to Hub] or [Exit Game] to get rid of your progress and be able to restart! :)
[/list]

I got caught up so much in trying to innovate on the genre that I got carried away and forgot about people who don't want that, as they are happy with how the genre goes. Overall, I think these are additions that should be welcome to everyone, and I hope yall enjoy them. :)

notes.title: Hidden Arcade - Day 3 Patch
notes.notes:
Day 3 Patch:

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Custom Player: Previously, when subscribing to custom maps, you had to either refresh multiple times or leave and enter the Custom Player machine again for the newly downloaded map to work - now, you can just refresh once and it will (/should) work.
[*] Custom Player: Playing a map, then loading another one will now properly reset the timer, reset the score to 0, and put all the Ghosts back where they belong, and scale them regularly again.
[*] Custom Player / Creator: In the custom maps, the Magnifgying Glass button sometimes took the camera to a random empty spot - no more! :) 
[*] Hub Area: Previously, if you disabled the speedrun timer, the toggle would not remember that. It would still be turned off in-game, but the toggle thought it is on again. No longer! :)
[/list]

Day 2 Update:

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
[list]
[*] Any Level: Additional UI elements like the home button, black-and-white toggle and the info icon will toggle off after a few seconds. You can toggle them on and off anytime using the escape key. This will prevent accidentally hitting the home button or b-w toggle.
[*] Any Level: Moving the image using either your mouse or WASD is now more dependent on the zoom level - the closer you're zoomed in, the less distance it covers. This prevents disorienting dragging.
[/list]

2nd Day 1 Patch Notes:

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Custom Creator: Ghost images now get saved properly.
[*] Custom Creator: Ghost positions now get saved properly.
[*] Custom Creator / Custom Player: Uploading and downloading custom levels should now work fluently.
[/list]

Day 1 Patch Notes:

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] All Levels: Fixed Leaderboard entries - displays you on top for now, then the 9 people worse than you.
[*] Custom Creator: Loading / selecting pre-existing levels refreshes properly.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
[list]
[*] All Levels: Added tool-tip for magnifying tool when hovered over.
[*] All Levels: Added info i to level that shows / explains controls when hovered over.
[*] All Levels: Changed tool-tip background textures for all Custom Creator buttons and adjusted colors.
[*] Custom Creator / Custom Player: Moved background texture to load in first to give clearer sign of progression.
[*] Custom Creator / Custom Player: Made it so that all Ghosts exchange their texture at once instead one after the other.
[/list]

Day 0 Patch Notes:

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Main Menu: Fixed the very glaringly obvious bug of clicks causing either the settings menu to open or the application to close.
[*] Custom Player: Fixed copying and loading custom Ghost textures properly.
[*] All Levels: Fixed clamping the magnifying-tool-usage properly into image.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
[list]
[*] Custom Creator: Added button to batch change all Ghost textures at once.
[*] Custom Creator: Added unique ID to user created levels that deals with multiple levels having the same name.
[*] Custom Creator / Custom Player: Added Ghost animation for texture exchange.
[/list]

notes.title: Hidden Arcade - Release Now!
notes.notes:
It's finally release time! YAAYYY!! You can find our Release Video right here:

[previewyoutube=M-K9hIP3kO8;full][/previewyoutube]

Q: What is this game about?
A: 💗 Find and free the hidden Ghosts spread throughout distinct Arcade Game Worlds, and create your own ones! 💗
Hidden Arcade is a Hidden Object point-and-click game in which the player has to find Ghosts inside of different Arcade Machines! ✨

Q: Why this game and not any other hidden object game?
A: The game's unique selling factor is that it innovates on the genre in many ways:
1) To add replayability, each level has a timer as well as a global leaderboard so that people can improve their times! You can of course turn it off if you would like a more relaxed experience. ✨
2) To add functionality, people can create their own levels using the Custom Creator! Pick your own background image, drag Ghosts around, scale them and exchange each Ghost's texture, insert custom sounds, give it a name and upload it to the Steam Workshop! ✨
3) To add community, everyone can download user-created levels and play them in the Custom Player! Clicking on any slot that says "Get more..." leads you straight to the Steam Workshop where you can subscribe to any levels you would like to play. Hitting refresh when you're back in the game will show all your new levels and allow you to enjoy them! ✨
4) To add color to the world, this game is available in color! This might not sound that big, but the vast majority of "100 xxx in xxx" games are black and white only. This game features beautiful artwork that took hours to complete, and you can choose whether to view it through a black-and-white lens, or to see all the colors it was drawn in! ✨ 

Q: Why should I get the game now?
A: For the Release Week, the Custom Creator is available to everyone! Just boot up the game and start making your own levels - don't worry, you'll be able to play user-created levels for free forever! But on Monday the 10th, the Custom Creator will be released as a DLC for 99 Cents instead. I would love to keep the game entirely free forever, but sadly, I need to insert some way to make back the 100 Dollars it cost to get the game on Steam, and I poured hundreds of unpaid hours into it. I hope that 99 cents for an optional level editor in a free game is an okay price to pay.

Q: I found an issue. What should I do?
A: Please tell me! Either in the Discussions form, or via email, you can tell me any feature you'd like, any bug you found, and I will try to address them as soon as possible!

Q: How could I possibly support such a fantastic free game?
A: Great that you're asking! If you can claim the game to add it to your library, let it run in the background and/or write a review for it, that would massively help me by boosting it in the almighty algorithm!

Alrighty that's everything for now I guess, hope u enjoy and ya see ya around goodbyeoo!
